record.body:
## Correction

Finding clear must be CLI-equivalent to the dashboard: use
`update --type project:finding --id <id> --expected-revision <rev>
--payload '{"needs":"none"}'` (claim/basis/invalidated_when may stay).
Do not document `supersede` for findings — findings have no superseded
lifecycle state, so supersede is illegal at runtime. Update
kinds-and-focus.md and any tests that assert supersede for needs-human.
